spawns._doc: Hollow Zombie spawn rules (13/11/2026). Only below the bedrock (Y < -64), on tunnel floors, never where block light >= maxLight (torches and flares make safe pockets, but do not scare away those already there), minDistance-maxDistance blocks from the player and out of sight. One attempt every intervalTicks per player in the zone; at most maxNear within nearRadius; pairChance for a second one next to it; none during graceTicks after entering the zone. crawlerChance = walks on all fours. They despawn beyond despawnDistance.
